The '''Shawken Spire''' was a [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shawken]]. Construction of the Spire took over nine [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]] to complete, by which [[Time/Legends|time]] the skyscraper had reached a low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] altitude. The Spire became a popular [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] tourist attraction before its destruction in [[18,780 BBY]]. Thousands of years later, in [[10,000 BBY]], the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]] included the Spire in his list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]]. By [[43 ABY]], the skyscraper had been rebuilt with more modern components.

==Description==
A particularly tall [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Shawken]], the Shawken Spire reached an altitude equal to low [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its destruction in [[18,780 BBY]]. By [[43 ABY]], it had been reconstructed with materials considered modern for the time.<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
The Shawken Spire was located on Shawken,<ref name="Atlas" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] home to one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most splendid civilizations.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|145|Shawken}}</ref> The skyscraper was erected over a period of approximately nine [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]]. By 18,780 BBY, the Spire had reached low-orbit altitude<ref name="Atlas" /> and was a popular Core Worlds tourist destination.<ref name="Blaster">{{InsiderCite|111|Blaster}}</ref> However, it was in that year that the Spire was destroyed.<ref name="Atlas" />

Despite the skyscraper's destruction, the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]] placed the Shawken Spire in his list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]], a compilation of [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] wonders created by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings that was released in his work ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]'' in [[10,000 BBY]]. By the end of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in 43 ABY, the Shawken Spire had been rebuilt with materials contemporary to the time.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I thought it was fun to imagine how an ancient culture would have built what is essentially a space elevator using 'primitive' materials.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|144|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>}}
The Shawken Spire was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a third-generation [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Essential Guide]] written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]]. The image of the Spire found in the ''Atlas'' was illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]].<ref name="Atlas" />
